recommended_rules: Do not auto-merge cross-source branded records on checksum-valid GTIN alone when name/brand/category signals materially conflict.
Treat GTIN-8 and retailer/internal short codes as market-scoped unless brand/product compatibility also passes.
Quarantine barcode groups with explicit identity conflicts; nutrition disagreement is supporting evidence, not sole identity evidence.
For generic foods, add token-order-invariant identity signatures while preserving preparation, state, cut, fat-level, salt, fortification, cultivar and physical-form qualifiers.
Add a curated versioned TR/EN food-identity lexicon; unspecified preparation must not auto-match an explicit raw/cooked/fried state.
Remove different checksum-valid GTIN pairs from the human merge queue and deterministically keep them separate.
